title: RegistryLogEntry
description: SAIA-Class S registry log entry representing an immutable audit record for registry operations within Beast System 3.0.

logId.description: Unique identifier for this log entry (UUID recommended).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the log entry was created.

operation.description: Type of registry operation (CREATE, UPDATE, ARCHIVE, REVOKE, LINK, ANCHOR).

entryId.description: ID of the registry entry affected by this operation.
